title: QE historical templates allow future/latest stock_pool to contaminate fixed backtest windows
description:
Expected: QE historical training/backtest templates use a point-in-time stock pool aligned with the fixed backtest window. For the default QE historical window test_end=2026-04-28 and backtest_end=2026-04-27, templates, MCP preflight, and backend validation should use or require filtered_pool_20260428 and reject filtered_pool dates later than test_end, such as filtered_pool_20260519. Paper/simulation/live flows may use their own cutoff/universe rules and should not affect historical backtests.
Actual: A custom_evo template created through QE MCP referenced filtered_pool_20260519 in loop.stock_pool and strategy_params.stock_pool. Backend validation could still return valid=true and materialize failed later with a missing stock pool RuntimeError/500. If the future/latest pool file exists, fixed historical backtests can be contaminated by a future universe.
reproduce_command: Create a custom_evo QE template with loop.stock_pool='filtered_pool_20260519' and strategy_params.stock_pool='filtered_pool_20260519' for test_end=2026-04-28/backtest_end=2026-04-27, then run qe_template_validate and qe_template_materialize_confirmed.
closure_requirements: Backend validate/approve/materialize gate rejects future/latest stock_pool contamination for QE historical templates.
MCP qe_template_create preflight rejects the same invalid payload before HTTP submission.
Custom-evo runtime preparation rejects invalid stock_pool before remote stock-pool sync.
Materialize no longer turns this resource/scope error into an unstructured 500.
Regression tests cover future and PIT stock pool cases.

events.note: Reported via aistock_mcp_server.report_bug; mirrored to GitHub issue #83.
Recovered BUG-070 from historical worktree because the linked GitHub issue existed but BUG JSON was not present on main.
Allowed scope updated to include actual backend, MCP, and regression test files touched by BUG-070 fix.
